name: Prostudent G
source:
By the end of the 20th century, radical educational reforms have transformed the Japanese society. Students were split into opposing groups, and the more aggressive of those eventually formed a dominant organization named Order of Black Phoenix, centered on the cult of a mysterious person known as "The Queen". Outcast students have escaped to a secluded island near Okinawa. A wandering lazy and lecherous manga and anime fan named Gorō Endō teams up with a female teacher and a few students to lead an opposition force against the oppressive governing circles.

Pro Student G is a Japanese-style erotic comedy adventure. The player guides Gorō through a series of locations and encounters, selecting choices from a menu to trigger the next event and advance the story. Some choices have a traditional verb-object structure, while others incorporate context-specific actions, many of which are included for humorous effect.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pro-student-g]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
20世纪末，激进的教育改革彻底改变了日本社会。学生分裂成彼此对立的团体，其中最具攻击性的势力最终组成了统治性组织“黑凤会”，并围绕被称为“女王”的神秘人物形成崇拜。遭排斥的学生逃到冲绳附近一座与世隔绝的岛屿。四处漂泊、懒散又好色的漫画动画迷远藤吾郎与一名女教师及几名学生联手，领导反抗力量对抗压迫性的统治集团。

《Pro Student G》是一款日式成人喜剧冒险游戏。玩家引导吾郎穿梭于不同地点、经历各种遭遇，通过菜单选择触发下一事件并推进故事。部分选项采用传统的“动词—对象”结构，另一些则会根据情境提供特定行动，其中许多只是为了制造喜剧效果。

[摘自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pro-student-g]Moby Games[/url]]
